_what_this_is: Every test the offline suite (a bare `flutter test` from the repository root)
is allowed to skip, and why. Read by `scripts/assert_suite_scope.py
--declared-skips`, which is run by `scripts/run_offline_suite.sh` on every
push. A skipped test that matches nothing here fails the run, and a rule here
that matches nothing in the run fails it too.
Task 11.156. The alternative was to assert how many tests are skipped, and a
count is the defect rather than the fix: it is a number somebody chose, it
stops describing anything the moment the population changes, and it cannot
tell 'one legitimate skip removed and one illegitimate skip added' from
'nothing happened'. These skips are nameable, so they are named.
`test` is the test's name as the JSON reporter gives it. `(suite)` is what
package:test calls a whole file skipped before any of its tests were reached
-- which is what a `skip:` in `dart_test.yaml`'s `tags:` block produces. It is
written here deliberately: it means these rules declare *whole files skipped
by their tag* and nothing else, so a `skip:` added to one individual test in
the same directory is still an undeclared skip and still fails the run.
Scope this file does not cover: a run on Windows. Two tests in
test/documentation/dev_stack_host_prerequisites_test.dart carry
`skip: Platform.isWindows ? 'needs a POSIX shell' : null`, which is null on
macOS and Linux, so they do not skip here and must not be declared -- a rule
matching nothing is a failure. On Windows those two would be reported as
undeclared skips. Nobody develops or runs CI for this project on Windows, and
a loud red there is a better answer than a rule that is allowed to match
nothing.
`runs_under_tz` (task 11.326): a test that skips itself unless the process
started under one zone. The suite runs under TZ=UTC by default and, at
night, under one zone east and one west of UTC; under the named zone the
rule is not in force and the test must run (the scope check is told the
zone with --tz). Everywhere else it is an ordinary declared skip.

skips.reason: dart_test.yaml skips the `e2e` tag by default so that a bare `flutter test` needs no server -- that is Phase 10 invariant 5 and README.md's promise. These files run under `scripts/run_e2e_tests.sh`, which passes `--tags e2e --run-skipped`. Two files in this directory are NOT tagged and do run here (suite_coverage_test.dart and publish_corpus_test.dart, which analyse the e2e suite rather than talking to a server); they are covered by no rule because they are not skipped.

dart_test.yaml skips the `network` tag by default. This file asks three tile providers whether they still publish the credit strings the app is legally required to show -- a question about the outside world, not about this commit, so it must never redden a push or fail on a laptop in the field. It runs weekly from .github/workflows/tile-credit-freshness.yml with `--tags network --run-skipped`, where the same scope check runs with --no-skips.

skips.test: clock matrix — fixed clocks for date-boundary logic (task 11.271) 11.269's picker: OK on the pre-filled day keeps the swap time — just after local midnight, America/Phoenix (UTC-7)
skips.reason: Needs the process's own zone to be America/Phoenix (UTC-7), which `clock_matrix_test.sh` supplies (`TZ=America/Phoenix`); `run_offline_suite.sh` defaults to `TZ=UTC` so that this suite skips the same four tests on every machine, instead of three on a Phoenix Mac, four anywhere else. Under `TZ=America/Phoenix` (the night's west-of-UTC run, task 11.326) `runs_under_tz` takes this rule out of force and the test must run.
